title: Compare shop category and item cancellation replay
platforms: Windows GNU under Wine/Xvfb; Linux interpreter model
changes: Document an isolated USA shop recording that changes to a nonadjacent category, selects an item and cancels, and compare its endpoint with two replay models.
validation: The 529-frame recording completed; the modeled category event matched its recorded final serialized state and guest clock, while key-only execution diverged. Protected originals and authenticated recording inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: The actual verifier rejects mouse:1028 before replay; the model bypasses parser and dispatcher. Wine synthetic input is not native Windows or physical input. Managed cleanup rejected the U31 directories and preserved the evidence.
